test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_lc_group_by ( metric LowCardinality(String), region LowCardinality(String), metric_plain String, region_plain String, value UInt64 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_lc_group_by SELECT concat('cpu.usage.mode.', toString(number % 12)), concat('us-east-', toString(number % 5)), concat('cpu.usage.mode.', toString(number % 12)), concat('us-east-', toString(number % 5)), number FROM numbers_mt(50000000)
test.query: SELECT metric, region, count(), sum(value) FROM t_lc_group_by GROUP BY metric, region FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 8
SELECT metric_plain, region_plain, count(), sum(value) FROM t_lc_group_by GROUP BY metric_plain, region_plain FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 8
